svg.title: Polybius Group Frame — annotated coordinate matrix
svg.desc: An 8×8 matrix showing the {p,∞,r} palindrome origin, row axis (separator levels), column axis (reading indices), hex anchors, and word16 interior cells. Three structural annotations explain the diagonal p\r cell, the return spine column, and the interior word16 formula.
svg.text: p and r meet before indexing
